prompts.beforego-01:
Square 1:1 illustration for a product website. It will be center-cropped to a 4:5 portrait panel, so keep every important element inside the central 75% of the width, with generous empty margin around the subject.
Style: calm modern editorial illustration, flat shapes with soft gouache shading and a fine risograph paper grain, gentle long soft shadows, rounded friendly forms, clean composition with one clear focal subject, lots of breathing room. Same art direction as a premium indie app studio website. Warm off-white paper background (#F5EEDF) filling the whole frame, no border, no frame, no vignette.
Palette: retro travel poster colors: deep teal #1F6B67, sunset orange #E5703A, mustard #E9B44C, sakura pink #F1B7B5, dark ink #22302F for outlines. Use at most 5 colors plus the background.

Small digits 1 2 3 are allowed only as day markers; no other numbers. Do not draw realistic app screenshots or photorealistic phones; if a phone appears it is a simple flat illustrated rounded rectangle.
Subject: a travel photo card (mountain and temple scene) dropping into a soft paper funnel and coming out below as a neat vertical stack of three day cards labeled only with the digits 1, 2, 3 and small place icons. Turning inspiration into a day-by-day plan.
